title: btHID Keyboard
author: @lunokjod
description:
This board as the keyboard of another device: the box under the bar is what you type in and every letter goes to the other device as a key press. Turn the radio on, pair with the name on the page, and the box is live.
This board is a keyboard and a mouse at once: the pointer is the app beside this one, and switching between them does not ask the other device to pair again.
